summary: A bank in {place} has passed examination and still needs currency at its counters.
realLife: Roosevelt described the federal printing bureau shipping currency and banks obtaining cash before reopening.
gates: An inspected bank is preparing to reopen.
weights: Expected withdrawals exceed cash already on hand.
inGame: needs: bank clearance, cash on hand and shipment status.

turns.what: The bank reopens with its existing cash.
turns.writesBack: The opening proceeds without a shipment.

turns.pulledBy: The delivery record shows a delay.
turns.writesBack: The bank posts revised counter hours.
